dmitri: Heads up - Product wants to extend SIEM export retention to 12 months for EU tenants. Two asks: (1) KMS impact on key rotation/unwrapping? (2) RBAC changes needed to lock down exported artifacts? cc @carla @mia
carla: KMS notes: we must preserve ability to decrypt old objects after rotation. Our standard is overlapping keys for 14 days and keeping key metadata with objects so unwrapping picks the right key id. Exporter needs to embed `key_id` and `created_by`.
mia: Agree. Also require exported objects be tagged `sensitivity:security_logs` and `region:EU` so downstream IAM and lifecycle jobs can act.
ben: RBAC proposal: limit bucket read to groups: sec-analysts, sec-oncall, forensics. Product/metrics teams get aggregated metrics only. Add JIT for exceptions (timeboxed).
dmitri: Runbook changes? Also need audit events to show who requested/approved/exported/and read artifacts during triage.
security: Audit requirements: exporter must emit events: export.created, export.approval.granted, export.object.read. Each event includes actor, request_id, justification, and acl_snapshot. Persist those to SIEM and replicate a subset to long-term archive.
carla: Draft RBAC policy example:
```json
{
  "resource": "projects/redwood/s3-exports/*",
  "bindings": [
    {"role": "roles/sec.analyst", "members": ["group:sec-analysts@redwood.com"]},
    {"role": "roles/sec.oncall", "members": ["serviceAccount:soc-oncall@redwood.com"]}
  ],
  "conditions": [{"title":"jit_window","expression":"request.time < timestamp_add(resource.metadata.requested_at, duration(7d))"}]
}
```
ben: Also require export TTL tag `ttl:365d` and a deletion job that enforces it. Deletion must handle KMS rotated objects: either retain old key material until deletion or re-encrypt carefully (prefer to retain old keys for archived objects).
sre-bot: deploybot: export-pipeline update started; config=siem-eu-retention-365d; author=ben; ts=2026-03-21T15:02:00Z
dmitri: For incident triage: keep raw, full-fidelity logs hot for 90d, then scrubbed/indexed alerts for 12 months. Exports are separate - they are customer-facing and need stricter access and audit trails.
mia: GDPR/compliance: add data minimization toggle - default strip direct user identifiers unless justification in request. Require `justification` field on approval and log it.
carla: I'll open a single ticket with checklist: KMS rotation plan, RBAC matrix update, runbook updates, audit event schema, deletion job. Linking: https://go.redwood.internal/issue/SEC-4389 and runbook draft: https://go.redwood.internal/runbooks/siem-export-handling
dmitri: Owners: KMS=infra-crypto (carla), RBAC+audit=security (mia + ben), runbook=dmitri. Target: draft by EOW, staged rollout next sprint. :thumbsup:
security: noted; will draft audit schema and retention justification template.
ben: Ping me for a quick RBAC JSON review.
carla: I'll add decrypt-validation steps in the runbook (script + sample objects) to confirm rotated keys can unwrap archived objects.
dmitri: Thanks all, logging action items to SEC-4389 now.
